## Other courses and lectures

::: {.lecture-list}
- In fall 2023, I taught two lectures on random forests at the [ECAS-SFdS school](https://www.sfds.asso.fr/fr/ecas2023/709-home/) during October 8-13. Other lecturers included Profs. Robin Genuer, Pierre Geurts, and Nathalie Vialaneix. The school was jointly organized by Profs. Jean-Michel Poggi and Robin Genuer.
- Random Forest Tutorial, Parts I, II, and III, with an RLT package example source file.
- Mayo-Illinois CompGen Workshop, summer 2018: [slides](https://www.dropbox.com/s/ft42shoc2m6to0p/Introduction.pdf?dl=0), [examples.rmd](https://www.dropbox.com/s/1li6apf2dw08lvt/examples.rmd?dl=0), [examples.pdf](https://www.dropbox.com/s/o8ummclqlhow7nc/examples.pdf?dl=0), and [prostate.RData](https://www.dropbox.com/s/2dozwlbb3tvubqh/prostate.RData?dl=0).
:::
